blocks.content: Linux install guide (x64 AppImage): chmod + run, the libfuse2 / --appimage-extract-and-run fallback, the ~/XtracsysCode data root, Ollama (install script) and llama.cpp backend setup, terminal-emulator fallback order (x-terminal-emulator → gnome-terminal → konsole → xfce4-terminal → alacritty), the Electron chrome-sandbox guidance (prefer the unprivileged_userns_clone sysctl over --no-sandbox), bash shell semantics with compound-command approval policy, build-from-source, and the verification checklist. Same honest status note as Windows: cross-compiled and structurally tested, on-hardware verification pending (R12).
Do not normalize global sysctl changes or --no-sandbox. Prefer supported sandbox-enabled environments; document any exceptional workaround and its risk.
